items.title: Apple CEO John Ternus believes that, while AI can be useful, Apple products should continue to be d…
items.text: Apple CEO John Ternus believes that, while AI can be useful, Apple products should continue to be designed primarily by humans and not AI. "The creation of products is a deeply human and personal thing, something that we love to do."
items.story: John Ternus says Apple doesn't “want to ship AI for AI's sake” and that Tim Cook is “available to help wherever I ask” on policy; Ternus has yet to meet Trump
